title: A canned line's saved price on a Default work order says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders.
  • Have a new canned line for this test, canned line A, with a part that has a saved price (for example $50.00).
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with canned line A added.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at the canned line part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens with canned line A's part at its saved price.

Step 2:

  • The details read "Saved price from canned line" and canned line A's name, ending with a period.
  • The details name Default as the source.
